answer.text: The fuel tank capacity is 17.0 L.
The manual gives the low fuel warning as 3 L ± 0.5 L, so about 3 litres is left in the tank when it comes on.

watchouts.text: If the last bar of the fuel level indicator in the cluster blinks continuously, the fuel is low and you should re-fuel immediately.
